post.hook: Gemini 4 Carbon ships to cyber defenders first
post.subhook: Plus: AI agents reach Anthropic data through third-party software

stories.headline: Google DeepMind releases Gemini 4 Carbon
stories.detail: Reported to top the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5; access starts with selected cyber defenders.

stories.headline: AI agents reach Anthropic systems via third-party software
stories.detail: In a Cathedral bug bounty test, Anthropic confirmed access to sales, HR and IT data but disputes how deep it went.

stories.headline: Reports: DeepSeek, Moonshot trained on GPT-6 Astra outputs
stories.detail: If confirmed, Chinese labs distilled a frontier OpenAI model, raising questions about reuse of model outputs.

stories.headline: Android Studio opens to third-party AI coding agents
stories.detail: More than 40 agents, including Claude Agent and Codex, work inside the IDE; Google also unveiled new Gemini APIs.

stories.detail: Free open model for transcription, translation and speaker recognition in up to 40 languages; works on recordings, not live audio.

stories.headline: Google takes AI Search and AI Mode ads global
stories.detail: Google is betting AI search can open new ad revenue as core search growth slows.

post.caption:
Google DeepMind's new frontier model goes to security experts before anyone else. Here's what changed today.

1. Google DeepMind releases Gemini 4 Carbon. It is reported to top the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5, with access initially limited to trusted cyber defenders. (Source: Google DeepMind)

2. In a bug bounty test, Cathedral used AI agents to reach parts of Anthropic's internal systems through third-party software. Anthropic confirmed access to sales, HR and IT data but disputes how deep it went. (Source: The Decoder)

3. Reports say DeepSeek and Moonshot used outputs from OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra to train their latest models. This is not yet confirmed. (Source: Reuters)

4. Android Studio now supports more than 40 third-party coding agents, including Claude Agent and Codex. Google also unveiled new Gemini APIs. (Source: The Decoder)

5. Nvidia released Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, a free, open model for transcription, translation and speaker recognition in up to 40 languages. It works on recordings, not live audio. (Source: Hugging Face)

6. Google is opening Gemini and Search to more third-party apps through a new developer platform. (Source: TechCrunch)

7. Anthropic launched Claude for Legal, with pre-built tools and database integrations for work like contract review. (Source: The Decoder)

8. OpenAI and ServiceNow expanded their partnership to bring OpenAI models and agents into ServiceNow workflows. (Source: OpenAI)

9. Google is expanding ads in AI Search and AI Mode to global markets as core ad growth slows. (Source: TechCrunch)

That's the day. See you tomorrow.

clusters.headline: Google DeepMind releases Gemini 4 Carbon frontier model, with access initially limited to trusted cyber defenders
clusters.why_it_matters: Reports say it tops the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5, and access is initially restricted to selected security experts.

clusters.headline: Reports say DeepSeek and Moonshot used outputs from OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra to train their latest models
clusters.why_it_matters: If confirmed, rival Chinese labs distilled a frontier OpenAI model, raising questions about model-output reuse and competitive pressure on US labs.

clusters.headline: Nvidia releases open Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe for multilingual speech transcription, translation and speaker recognition
clusters.why_it_matters: It is a free, open model that handles up to 40 languages, but it works on recordings rather than live audio.

clusters.headline: Cathedral uses AI agents to access parts of Anthropic's internal systems through third-party software in a bug bounty test
clusters.why_it_matters: Anthropic confirmed access to sales, HR and IT data but disputes how deep it went, showing that external software dependencies expose even leading AI labs.

clusters.headline: Anthropic launches Claude for Legal tools with pre-built templates and integrations
clusters.why_it_matters: Legal teams get pre-built interactive tools and connections to their own databases for routine work like contract review.

clusters.headline: OpenAI and ServiceNow expand their partnership to bring OpenAI models and agents into ServiceNow workflows
clusters.why_it_matters: Enterprise workflows get closer integration between OpenAI models and agents and ServiceNow's platform in both directions.

clusters.headline: Google opens Android Studio to third-party AI coding agents and unveils new Gemini APIs
clusters.why_it_matters: Android developers can use more than 40 coding agents, including Claude Agent and Codex, inside the IDE.

clusters.headline: Google launches Gemini Search and Gemini integrations for more third-party apps through a new developer platform
clusters.why_it_matters: Businesses can bring their services into Google's AI experiences, which could change how consumers discover apps.
